Summarise monthly WOA data across months

Source: R/woa.R
woa_summarise_monthly.Rd

Takes a directory of monthly WOA .nc files (e.g., 12 files for January to December) and computes the min, max, and max-minus-min (diff) across months at each depth layer. Works for any WOA variable.

Usage

woa_summarise_monthly(monthly_dir = NULL, field = "an", files = NULL)

Arguments

monthly_dir

Character. Path to directory containing monthly WOA .nc files. All .nc files in the directory are loaded.

field

Character. Statistical field to select from each file. Default "an".

files

Character vector. Optional explicit list of files (overrides monthly_dir).

Value

Named list of SpatRasters: min, max, diff. Each uses the {variable}_depth={value} layer naming convention.

Details

Replaces the ad-hoc loop in data-raw/WOA.R.
